name: rag
description: Operational console AND retrieval guide for the ragtools local RAG product. Install, configure, diagnose, repair, upgrade, and run the local knowledge base — and teach Claude to use it correctly: scope every search (ragtools refuses unscoped calls), check a project indexing mode before code questions, resolve the right service among several, and validate citation paths. Does NOT re-implement search.

service_port.title: ragtools service port
service_port.description: Port the hooks use to reach ragtools. 0 probes 21420 (installed) then 21421 (source install). RAG_PLUGIN_SERVICE_PORT is the fallback.

hook_decision_log.title: Hook decision log
hook_decision_log.description: Record one line of decision metadata (no prompt text) per prompt in the plugin data directory. Rotates at 1 MB.
